[RHIM.7.1] A logical fact whose left-hand side matches a hydrated fact must have
its lifetime bounded above by the shortest-lived element of that left-hand side
([LHYD.10.5]). When the left-hand side includes a hydrated fact, the logical
fact's upper bound is that hydrated fact's `retain:` expiry, so the logical fact
does not outlive the hydrated data that justifies it.
